**About Bolt

**Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

**Why join Bolt?

**

• Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.

• Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.

• Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.

• Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.

**About The Role

**Bolt for Business is scaling fast — and corporate mobility is one of the biggest opportunities ahead of us. As Regional Sales Manager, you'll lead up to 8 country-based sales teams, owning the strategy and execution behind how businesses of all sizes manage employee mobility and ground transportation. This isn't just team management — it's building and scaling a B2B sales engine across multiple markets, with real autonomy to shape how we win.

_Please note that this role can be based in one of the following locations: Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Norway, or Germany.

_**Main Tasks And Responsibilities

**

• Lead across borders. Manage and coach multiple country-based B2B sales teams, building a culture of consistently high performance across your region.

• Own the strategy, not just the execution. Set the go-to-market approach for your region — team structure, pipeline planning, lead allocation, and KPIs built for enterprise sales cycles.

• Drive real revenue growth. Go after high-value corporate accounts that deliver strong ROI and accelerate Bolt for Business's expansion into new markets.

• Build the team you lead. Partner closely with recruitment to hire and develop a high-performing, cross-country B2B sales organization from the ground up.

• Solve problems that matter. Spot what's blocking growth in corporate sales motions, and lead entrepreneurial projects that test new approaches to enterprise acquisition — this is a role for people who like building, not just maintaining.

• Operate at a senior level. Lead key enterprise contract negotiations, deliver accurate forecasts to senior leadership, coach your sales managers, and stay ahead of market and competitor trends in B2B mobility.

**About You

**

• An entrepreneurial mindset — you take ownership, move fast in ambiguity, and are always looking for smarter ways to scale.

• 3+ years leading B2B or enterprise sales teams, with hands-on experience in performance management and coaching.

• 2+ years as an individual contributor in B2B sales, with a strong track record of exceeding targets — ideally in digital marketplaces, mobility, or enterprise services.

• A data-driven approach to pipeline planning, budgeting, and resource allocation across multiple markets.

• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, managing complex B2B pipelines and tracking team performance.

• Executive-level communication and presentation skills — you're comfortable in the room with senior stakeholders.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, adapting quickly with solution-oriented thinking.

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L ownership in a B2B context.

• Fluent English, and openness to frequent travel across your markets to stay close to your local teams.

**Why You’ll Love It Here

**

• Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.

• Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.

• Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.

• Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.

• Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.

• Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.

_Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

_At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

**Everyone is welcome

**Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

Make a difference in the scalability of biomanufacturing

Enduro Sense is used for cell-based expression systems and production strains to deliver higher titer, rate and yields, making biomanufacturing more efficient and scalable.

As we expand to meet growing client demands, we are seeking a results-driven research scientist to contribute to our microbial strain engineering projects with clients and strengthen our tech platform.

Who You Are:

This role is perfect for an industry-seasoned scientist passionate about leveraging synthetic biology to create tangible client impact while closely collaborating with team members. You thrive in fast-paced settings, maintaining high scientific standards, and are eager to join a growing biotech company, currently about 25 employees.

Responsibilities:

• 
Drive forward strain engineering activities (cloning, transformation of bacteria and yeasts)

• 
Develop, implement and execute high-performance strain cultivation assays

• 
Carefully document lab work, document and analyse data

• 
Collaborate with fellow scientists of all levels to deliver on project timelines and deliverables.

• 
Industry Experience: 2+ years in microbial strain engineering, with corporate expertise in pharmaceutical or industrial bioprocesses.

Exceptional team-work, collaboration and lab documentation skills.

Why Join Enduro Genetics?

At Enduro, you'll play a vital role rolloing out our technology to leading clients, shaping the future of biomanufacturing. Be part of a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions make a difference.

If you're ready to advance your career in industrial biotechnology and contribute to impactful projects, apply now to join our team.

About Us

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk we have embarked on an industry-defining transformation, on a bold new direction, expanding our capabilities to become a true end-to-end logistics provider that can deliver intelligent solutions for customers around the world. It’s a big moment for all of us – and we all have our part to play.

We Offer

The Global Marine Labour Relations team is responsible for the following main areas:

The job is site based in Copenhagen in Maersk’s offices in Nordhavn and expected to joun our colleagues at Esplanaden in 2027. You will join a passionate group of colleagues in the Marine People & Culture Team, which is part of the global Fleet Management & Technology organization.

Building AI keeps getting cheaper and faster. Deciding what's worth building, and getting an organisation to actually commit to it, does not.

At Heyra, we build AI systems, workflows and data platforms that are meant to live in production from day one. We work closely with companies that are moving quickly and need a partner who can hold both the strategic picture and the delivery reality in one head.

We're looking for a Deployment Strategist: the person the client's leadership talks to. You own the relationship and the outcome. You sit with a C-suite buyer, understand where their business is actually trying to go, and translate that into a sharp, sequenced plan for what we build and why. Then you steer a strong engineering team to make it real - without being the one in the codebase.

This is the strategic counterpart to our engineers. Where they go deep into the build, you hold the commercial and strategic frame: what problem are we really solving, what impact are we creating, in what order, and how do we get the organisation to adopt it. You're more product manager than a traditional consultant, with a strong strategic angle - closer to an Engagement Manager who's technical enough to make the right calls than a slide-deck advisor.

You'll work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

What you'll work on

• 
Owning client relationships at the leadership level - being the person the C-suite trusts

• 
Framing the real problem behind the ask, and shaping it into an engagement worth running together with our FDEs

• 
Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

• 
Steering engineering teams toward outcomes, translating in both directions between the client and the builders

• 
Driving adoption: managing expectations, working with the people who have to live with the solution, and staying through the part after launch

• 
Scoping, structuring and de-risking engagements as they evolve

• 
Spotting where the next opportunity sits inside an account and growing it

**Requirements

****You probably have experience with

**

• 
Management consulting, change management, adoption, implementation of AI-native solutions.

• 
Owning client or stakeholder relationships end to end, with real accountability for outcomes

• 
Product, programme or engagement leadership in a technical environment

• 
Being technically literate - fluent enough in data and AI to make the right calls and earn trust with both buyers and builders, without needing to write the production code yourself

• 
Translating between business strategy and what's actually buildable

• 
Bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations

• 
The patience to sit with a worried manager, and the stubbornness to stay until adoption actually lands

Curiosity, taste and the way you think matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience. We hire for the who, not the what - experience is an indicator of perspective, not a deciding factor for how senior a role you'll play here. We're hiring across levels and shape the role around the person.

Why Heyra

At Heyra, we believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We're building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build, and operate AI products that change how enterprises work - from problem to prototype to production.

We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high.

**You'll Join a Team Where

**

• 
people care deeply about what they build

• 
good ideas move quickly

• 
new technology gets explored early

• 
and where there is room to shape both the company and the way we work

We're around 50 people today after merging with Pyne, and we're only just getting started.

If owning how AI engagements get framed, sold and landed at Heyra sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**

Social gatherings

New tech gear

Central office

Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• 
Skill development

Paid holiday

Remote work allowed

Pet friendly

jobs.occupation: Experienced Electronics Engineer for Manufacturing Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an engineering role where you help turn advanced sports technology into scalable, high-quality products? At Trackman, you will play a key role in industrializing, testing, and producing innovative hardware solutions bridging R&D and production with real technical influence and cross-functional impact.

**Your Role

**As an experienced Engineer in “Manufacturing Engineering” which is a part of the “Hardware Development & Supply” organization, you will act as a key technical contributor across R&D and Production. Your responsibilities will be to ensure that Trackman’s new and existing hardware platforms can be produced reliably, at scale and volume.

You will be expected to ensure design for manufacturing (DFM).  This involves challenge designs, propose improvements, and drive best practices across the organization in close collaboration with R&D hardware, tracking and software teams, in-house production, EMS suppliers, supply chain, and management.

This role suits an experienced engineer who enjoys combining hands-on engineering with technical expertise and ownership.

What you will be doing

• Specifying, developing, and driving a strategy for production- and test engineering equipment to support new and existing hardware platforms. We work with GHZ Radars, Computer Modules, Camera Sensors and other state of the art electronics.

• Act as an experienced technical interface between R&D and Production, ensuring manufacturability and testability are built in from early design phases.

• Design, build and validate production- and test solutions for all relevant technologies. This includes fixtures for assemblies, automation, “bed of nails” setups, and other supporting electronics.

• Develop automated test solutions using NI TestStand, Python, and C#, including data handling, traceability, and statistical analysis.

• Perform hands-on debugging utilizing signal generators, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes ect. for root-cause analysis.

• Participate in schematic entry, reviews, placement and carry out layout and routing of simple PCBs used in test fixtures and support electronics

• Drive collaboration with EMS suppliers, including transfer, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of test and production processes

• Analyze production and test data to improve yield, quality, and robustness, and to support data-driven decision-making

• Strengthen the ability to plan and execute according to plan, i.e. spending part of your time doing project coordination work supporting the whole team.

Job requirements

**What You Bring

**We imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Electronics Engineering and have extensive experience (5+ years) within electronics development, production, or test engineering

• Have strong practical experience with test development, electronics debugging, and production environments

• Advanced user of relevant lab test equipment (e.g., oscilloscope, signal generators, spectrum analyzers etc.)

• Are comfortable taking technical ownership and influencing decisions across teams and senior stakeholders

• Work in a structured, proactive way and naturally drive improvements

• Fluent in Danish and English, written and spoken and located in Denmark

Technical skills:

• Advanced experience with Python, NI TestStand, C# and data analysis.

• Experience with RF measurements in the GHz range and understanding of schematics.

• Experience in implementing test equipment at EMS suppliers, transferring test data between different sites

• Knowledge of camera and optics calibration principles.

The Office  We are located in our state-of-art HQ in Hørsholm, located at DTU Science Park. We take great pride in the building we designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness centre, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology  Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Manager, GTM Operations and Enablement

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Role

Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions - Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As Manager, GTM Operations and Enablement, you'll set the standard for how GTM processes are designed, governed, and continuously improved, and you'll own the enablement methodology and launch readiness framework that keep execution consistent as we scale. You'll lead a small operations team, and partner closely with Product on launch readiness and funnel governance.

Responsibilities

> Own and maintain the stage/funnel definition framework — the documented, governed standard for what each pipeline stage means across Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led, including the audit process that keeps motions compliant with it.

> Build and maintain the enablement methodology toolkit — playbook templates, certification criteria, and onboarding frameworks that motion-level teams use to run their own enablement, plus the review process that keeps that toolkit current.

> Own the launch and market readiness framework, ensuring new products and campaigns hit the market with the right cross-functional prep.

> Define and track the funnel health and enablement scorecards — stage conversion rates, launch readiness scores, methodology/certification adoption — that show whether the standards are actually working, and use them to prioritize the CI roadmap.

> Run continuous improvement (CI) cycles that identify friction across the funnel and turn it into standardized process fixes, grounded in the scorecard data above.

> Lead and grow a small operations team, keeping their work aligned to one set of standards regardless of which functions it spans.

> Partner closely with Product on launch readiness and stage/funnel governance.

Requirements

Experience > 5+ years of experience in GTM/sales enablement, revenue operations, or process design, ideally across more than one go-to-market motion.

> Experience managing a small, functionally diverse team.

Process & Program Skills > Track record of building methodology and standards that other teams adopt and run with - not just delivering enablement content yourself.

> Strong process-design instincts: comfortable defining funnel stages, launch checklists, and CI frameworks from scratch.

**

Operating Skills

**> Confident partnering with Product and cross-functional teams on launch and market readiness.

> Clear, structured communicator who can turn ambiguous process gaps into simple, adoptable standards.

> Comfortable setting standards for teams with different day-to-day priorities, without owning their execution.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Specialistläkare/överläkare inom kardiologi till Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse, Danmark
jobs.description:
Om du är på jakt för nya utmaningar på jobbet och funderar på att jobba i Danmark är kardiologen på Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Slagelse ett självklart val.

Här kan du vara med och påverka framtidens hjärtmedicin och samtidigt få möjlighet att utveckla och leda ditt eget specialområde.

På hjärtmedicinska avdelningen (Medicin 2) kommer du som specialistläkare att spela en central roll för den kliniska verksamheten och yrkesområdets utveckling. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med avdelningens övriga specialistläkare, chefer och andra professioner för att skapa smidiga och sammanhängande patientförlopp.

Yrkesmässiga utmaningar och ett flexibelt arbetsliv

Som specialistläkare hos oss får du inte bara en tjänst. Du får möjlighet att styra inriktningen inom ett eller flera specialområden, om du har ambitionen och intresset för det.

Du får

• möjlighet att ta ansvar för och utveckla ett helt eget specialområde inom exempelvis ischemi, arytmi, hjärtklaffssjukdomar eller bilddiagnostik i form av ekokardiografi, hjärt-CT och hjärt-MR

• möjlighet att delta i forskningen vid avdelningen

• möjlighet att ingå i en högspecialiserad miljö med engagerade kollegor

• ett nära samarbete med övriga professioner och en hög grad av kollegialt utbyte.

Dessutom kan vi anpassa tjänsten så att den passar dina behov. På Medicin 2 lägger vi stor vikt vid att skapa balans mellan arbete och fritid, och vi prioriterar stort inflytande och ansvar.

Om dig

Vi tror att du

• är specialistläkare i kardiologi, eller är på väg att bli det

• fokuserar på att utveckla vårdkvaliteten och förbättra patientförloppet

• trivs i en miljö där man både för ett nära samarbete och arbetar självständigt

• bidrar till en aktiv och god arbetsmiljö

• har ett intresse för kvalitet, utbildning och eventuellt forskning

• kommunicerar öppet och konstruktivt.

Om oss

Vår avdelning bedriver verksamhet i två olika lokaler i Næstved respektive Slagelse, som ligger 30 km från varandra.

I Slagelse består avdelningen av två vårdavdelningar med 24 respektive 20 sängplatser. Därutöver har vi en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning.

I Næstved består avdelningen av ett trombos- och koagulationscentrum, en hjärtmottagning samt det vårdmässiga ansvaret för en hormonmottagning. Utöver detta rymmer lokalerna även ett diagnostiskt centrum.

Vi är för närvarande 12 specialistläkare inom kardiologi samt specialistläkare inom avdelningens övriga specialistfunktioner.

Vi ansvarar för undervisningen av medicinstudenter från Köpenhamns universitet.

Därför ska du välja Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- och Vestsjællands Hospital fokuserar vi på yrkeskompetens, samarbete mellan professioner, kvalitet, utbildning och forskning.

Specialister spelar en central roll både för den kliniska verksamheten och för den ämnesspecifika utvecklingen, och du blir en del av en miljö med hög grad av specialisering, tydliga ambitioner och goda möjligheter att påverka utvecklingen inom ditt specialistområde.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där fokus ligger på vårdkvalitet, kontinuitet i patientförloppet och förutsättningar som främjar såväl kliniskt arbete som utbildning och forskning.

Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats kommer att vara i Slagelse som har goda transportförbindelser med bland annat Odense, Köpenhamn och övriga Själland.

Är du redo för nästa steg?

Vill du vara med och utveckla kardiologin på Midt- og Vestsjælland? Då ser vi gärna att du hör av dig.

Mer information

Om du vill ha mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta tillförordnad chefsläkare Roman Sykulski på tel. +45 56 51 41 34 eller chefsjuksköterska Camilla Vest på tel. +45 93 56 84 89.

Villkor, lön och anställning

Du kommer att ingå i ett jourteam med bakjoursansvar från ditt eget hem i egenskap av överläkare och ha jour utanför arbetsplatsen i egenskap av specialistläkare.

Vi har omfattande erfarenhet av att hitta flexibla lösningar som möjliggör ett hållbart arbetsliv, så kontakta oss gärna för ett förutsättningslöst samtal om vilka möjligheter som finns.

Den professionella bedömningen av sökanden kommer att baseras på sökandens uppgifter om sina egna kompetenser i förhållande till de sju läkartjänsterna. Om du söker en tjänst som överläkare kommer en professionell bedömning att genomföras som kommer att vara avgörande för din kvalifikation som överläkare.

Anställningen sker enligt avtalet mellan Danske Regioner och YL/Overlægeforeningen, beroende på vilken tjänst som söks, och är villkorad med att det finns en tillfredsställande børneattest (utdrag ur belastningsregistret som visar om en person dömts för sexualbrott mot barn under 15 år).

Vi önskar tillsätta tjänsten senast eller enligt överenskommelse.

Hjälp med flytt och undervisning i danska

Om du vill flytta till Danmark i samband med anställningen erbjuder vi kostnadsfri, professionell hjälp med flytt och bosättning nära sjukhuset eller eventuellt i Köpenhamn. Du får hjälp med allt från att hitta boende till registrering och eventuella medföljande familjemedlemmar.

En viktig del av arbetet som specialistläkare är kommunikationen mellan läkare och patient. För patientsäkerhetens skull kräver därför Region Sjælland att våra specialistläkare ska ha kunskaper i danska språket på en tillfredsställande nivå. Vi tillhandahåller därför en språklärare för privatundervisning så att du så snabbt som möjligt kan kommunicera med dina patienter på en nivå där ni förstår varandra.

Det innebär att vi förväntar oss att du är inställd på att lägga tid på att lära dig danska, både i tal och skrift.

Se mer om vad vi erbjuder i form av hjälp här

Rekryteringsprocessen

När vi har mottagit din ansökan kommer vi att bedöma om dina kvalifikationer matchar det vi söker, och du kommer initialt att bjudas in till en intervju via Teams. Om båda parter är intresserade av att fortsätta dialogen kommer du att bjudas in till ett rekryteringssamtal på sjukhuset, där du får träffa avdelningens ledning och personal samt vår HR- och språkkonsult.

Ansökningstid

Vi kommer att granska ansökningarna till tjänsten löpande, så vänta inte för länge med att ansöka.

Verksamhetsområde

Den 1 januari 2027 slås Region Själland och Region Hovedstaden samman och bildar Region Østdanmark till följd av sjukvårdsreformen. Ditt verksamhetsområde kommer att vara Region Østdanmark, inklusive alla tillhörande organisatoriska enheter.

Läs mer om vad verksamhetsområdet innebär på Region Østdanmarks webbplats.

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbetar vi varje dag för att främja ett hälsosamt liv genom förebyggande åtgärder och behandling inom ramen för en samordnad hälso- och sjukvårdsinsats. Som sjukhus förenar vi psykiatri och somatik. Vårt mål är att patienter och medborgare ska få bra och trygg vård av hög kvalitet.

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett innovativt, kompetent och organisatoriskt stabilt sjukhus där vi gör skillnad för de människor som behöver oss. Lärande och utveckling är en del av vardagen och sker i professionella sammanhang med ett gemensamt ansvar. Det sker även mellan olika avdelningar.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital betjänar ett upptagningsområde med cirka 230 000 invånare. Vi har 766 vårdplatser och cirka 5 000 anställda fördelade på 20 avdelningar, däribland 16 somatiska och psykiatriska avdelningar.

Vi erbjuder en gedigen forskningsmiljö med 13 professorer och en stark yrkesmässig utbildningsmiljö, där vi varje år välkomnar cirka 2 700 studenter, elever och läkare som deltar i vidareutbildning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.

Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

Oplysninger om lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai

Oplysninger om dette lønniveau kommer fra kapa.ai. Din faktiske løn vil være baseret på dine kompetencer og din erfaring – tal med din rekrutteringskonsulent for at høre mere.

Grundlønsniveau

Job Description

Would you like to be part of exciting and challenging projects within the IT world? Do you dream of having the opportunity to contribute to some of Denmark’s most business-critical IT solutions? Then we have the ideal student job for you.

At Netcompany, we are looking for a student who wants to take part in our innovative projects. Here, you will have the chance to influence our solutions while working alongside some of the industry’s most skilled colleagues, who will inspire you and support your learning.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a student assistant with us, you will be given responsibility from day one and become an important part of one of our teams. You will experience how your work directly contributes and creates value in the solutions we deliver to our clients. A student position with us gives you the opportunity to take on challenging tasks on equal footing with our full-time consultants.

We follow a well-established methodology from identifying client needs to implementing and rolling out solutions. You will therefore gain hands-on experience with developing IT systems from start to finish. You will primarily work on IT solutions and service-oriented architectures based on .NET and Java technologies, typically within maintenance, development and testing. The role provides the opportunity to put many of the skills gained during your studies into practice.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing functional and technical designs for system components.

• Programming tasks across all layers of the system.

• Configuration and development of extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes.

About you

We are looking for a student who can work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to project deadlines and other key milestones. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field.

• Have some experience with object-oriented programming and familiarity with languages such as C# .NET and/or Java.

• Are highly motivated and eager to develop your skills.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Retire the ERP

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers - automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Fuse Energy.

We're an early team defining a new software category. Think engineers who love debits and credits, designers who care about reconciliation states, and operators who treat finance as a product. If you're excited to modernise how companies run money, you're in the right place.

Backed by world-class investors including Balderton and Atomico and advised by industry titans, we're building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About the Role

You'll sit at the heart of our Customer function and work with our most important customers. You’ll make sure they understand the value Light brings them and drive renewals and upsell.

Your customers are Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs at fast-growing multinational SaaS and tech companies. Senior, technical, time-poor. They expect you to keep up, to tell them straight when something won't work, and to make their team the hero.

We’re a young company, and we’re just starting to renew contracts. In parallel, we’re deploying Agentic Customer Engineers who help our customers make the most of Light. While they re-design customer workflows and deploy agents, you’ll own the stakeholders, the adoption, and the commercial in this motion. There's no set playbook yet. You'll write it, and we'll help.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Own existing customer relationships and drive adoption, renewal and upsell

• 
Ensure that Controllers, Finance Directors, and CFOs see the value Light brings

• 
Make finance the hero - help them do their best work and get recognition for it

• 
Partner two-in-a-box with Agentic Customer Engineers to help customers make the most of Light and our suite of AI agents

• 
Spot an engagement going sideways before the customer does, and fix it

• 
Feed what you learn back into the playbook the team is building

Experience & Qualifications

• 
5+ years owning customers in account management, customer success, consulting, or a commercial delivery role - with outcomes you can point to

• 
You hold your own with a CFO. You can talk multi-entity finance, ROI, and adoption without flinching, and you know when to push back

• 
You've driven adoption and expansion, not just kept accounts warm and sent QBRs

• 
You bring structure to messy, ambiguous engagements - clear plans, sharp prioritisation, and the judgement to know which details matter

• 
You've owned accounts and driven outcomes

• 
You use AI tools daily and have specific opinions on where they help and where they don't

• 
Fluent English; additional European languages a plus

• 
Bonus #1: Finance or accounting background

• 
Bonus #2: Experience in a forward-deployed, solutions-led, or professional-services model focused on renewals and upsell, ideally in the context of AI

You'll probably struggle here if

• 
You need a big support team, a mature playbook, and a manager on call to operate - this is a founding role with limited scaffolding

• 
You can't give a concrete example of telling a senior customer "no" and making it stick

• 
You love the status quo - this job is about change more than maintenance

• 
You've used ChatGPT once and weren't impressed - we go all in on AI at Light

The good stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a really fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary + potential stock options

🏝 Generous package of paid annual leave + public holidays

🥳 Regular socials and company off-sites (last time was in Piemonte, next time is in Provence)

🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you'll help shape a market-defining motion

The famous last words

Working at Light means you're embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat-code is that we've built something like this before - and are now doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it's taking off 🚀

Light is the new way to run multinational finances for modern technology companies. Run AR, AP, expenses, bookkeeping, and financial reporting automatically across all your entities — without the chaos of multiple systems. Crafted and built by the designers and engineers behind world-class companies like Spotify, X, AWS, Klarna, Google and Shopify, we empower multinational finances with a joyful user experience like no other.

About the job

Chainalysis is the cryptocurrency ghostbusters, pioneering in the blockchain analysis space. Identifying high-risk activities on the blockchain, playing a central role in ensuring cryptocurrencies are used for a legitimate purpose. Ultimately, Chainalysis is building trust in blockchains.

The Chainalysis engineering team solves large scale, technically complex data problems by ingesting, transforming and supporting nearly 1TB of data per day across multiple blockchains serving public and private sectors internationally. Our industry is evolving at a rapid pace and our job is to build a flexible platform that will allow us to adapt accordingly.

Software Engineers are at the epicenter of that mission by building and scaling the data pipelines, infrastructure and applications our customers rely on every day to stop crime, reduce financial risk and prevent financial loss.

In This Role You Will

• Be part of an Student Developer cohort from September 2026 - February 2027, working with a specific team and benefiting from local mentors

• Collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to solve real-world problems, features that demystify crypto data, facilitate collaboration between customers in their investigations, improve our data pipelines and workflows, and more

• Develop and deploy high quality code using modern frameworks and technologies within AWS and GCP such as lambdas, Kafka, S3, Java, Typescript, Databricks, etc.

• Debug production issues and participated in a blameless post-mortem process to make our systems stronger

To Achieve Success In This Role You Have

• Customer-centric mindset to ship performant, scalable and well-tested code to production

• A strong sense of urgency and solid working engine

• Computer Science degree (or similar technical degree) in progress with an expected graduation date during 2027

• Demonstrated applications development or data engineering experience from previous internships, work experience, coding/startup competitions, open source contributions or publications

• Participated in code and architecture reviews at internships or open source projects

• Used or been exposed to React/Angular, Kafka, Spring boot and Postgres

• Strong interest in learning about cryptocurrencies from some of the most knowledgeable people in the field

About Chainalysis

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, and investigate criminal cases. As adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That’s where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what’s happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

You belong here.

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About the company

Do you want to take a central role in shaping how a high‑tech defense company secures reliability, compliance and world‑class product integrity on a global scale? As the new QHSE Director at Sky Watch, you will own and continuously evolve the company’s Quality and HSE foundation, ensuring that our products, processes and teams operate at a consistently high and predictable standard across the entire value chain.

You will be responsible for safeguarding Sky-Watch’s Quality Management System, driving compliance with AS9100, ISO 9001 and AQAP, and enabling stable, scalable execution in an increasingly demanding international defense environment. Through strong cross functional leadership and data driven governance, you will strengthen decision making, reduce operational risk, accelerate execution stability and help deliver a dependable customer experience built on safety, performance and traceability.

Joining Sky‑Watch means stepping into a fast‑growing scale‑up where reliability is a strategic differentiator — and where your expertise will directly influence both day‑to‑day operations and the company’s ongoing global growth journey.

You will report directly to the CEO, including direct leadership responsibility for the QA Manager and dotted line leadership of the QC Manager.

In this role, you act as a trusted advisor to the Executive Management Team, providing clear, fact based recommendations on quality, risk and compliance, and contributing actively to strategic decision‑making at enterprise level.

Your key responsibilities include:

• QHSE Strategy & Policy

• Sky‑Watch QMS (AS9100 / ISO 9001 / AQAP)

• Quality Governance & Risk Management

• Digital QHSE & Data Governance

• Continuous Improvement & NCR / CAPA

• Supplier Quality Requirements & APQP / PPAP

• Manufacturing Quality & QC oversight

• Audits & Compliance

• Health, Safety & Environment (in collaboration with the Health & Safety

• Organization / AMO)

• People Leadership & Cross‑functional Collaboration

To succeed in this role, you hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing or a related technical field, combined with at least 10 years of experience in global Quality/QHSE leadership within regulated, high‑tech industries with full value chain such as defense, aerospace or equivalent.

You have demonstrated strong results in defect reduction, execution stability and QMS maturity, and you bring hands on experience with MRB, concessions, PPAP and supplier audits. You possess deep knowledge of AS9100, AQAP and ISO 9001 requirements and are comfortable working with lifecycle product safety in a regulated environment.

You work confidently with structured problem‑solving and quality methodologies such as RCA, FMEA, Control Plans and capability analysis, and you are experienced in configuration and document control to ensure consistency and traceability. In addition, you bring strong digital QHSE literacy, using data governance, dashboards and digital adoption to create transparency, support sound decision making and drive continuous improvement across the organisation.

You are based within approximately one hour’s driving distance from Støvring and are willing to travel around 20–30 days per year.

As a person, you take ownership of your responsibilities and bring energy and commitment to your work. You are proactive and structured, balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, and remain calm and focused in a fast‑changing environment. With a strong analytical and curious mindset, you are able to translate complex quality, risk and compliance topics into clear, actionable messages that create understanding, alignment and strong buy‑in across senior leadership and the wider organization. You work collaboratively across functions, build trust with key stakeholders, and act as a credible role model for quality, integrity and professional judgement.

Are you the new QHSE Director at Sky‑Watch in Støvring? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion.

For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and no application deadline is set.

Job Description

Do you find Threat Hunting, Threat Intelligence, SIEM, and EDR exciting, and do you want to be a deciding factor in IT Security in our internal as well as our customers’ environments? As a Purple Security Engineer, you will ensure operations can perform their security-related tasks based on guidelines you help define.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a Purple Security Engineer, you will be a part of Netcompany Operations and our dedicated Security team. Your work will involve defending critical infrastructure such as airports, large financial institutions, government systems, and other essential sectors.
